summary: Modiv Industrial, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement with Global Net Lease, Inc. (GNL). Under the agreement, Modiv will merge with a GNL subsidiary; each share of Modiv common stock and preferred shares will be converted into the right to receive consideration as defined in the agreement. The Modiv board unanimously approved the transaction. The merger structure involves a double-merger mechanism: first the company merges into GNL Merger Sub, then its operating partnership merges into GNL OpCo Merger Sub. The transaction is subject to customary conditions including shareholder and regulatory approvals. The price per share, premium, and expected closing date were not disclosed.
